operations.name: Bucket merit evidence into reporting week

semantics.reporting_rule: Merit evidence is bucketed into recurring one-week intervals based on the identity registration-date cadence.
semantics.anti_multiplication_rule: Splitting a Project/week into hour atoms cannot multiply qualifying Tier evidence beyond the actual underlying work/evidence.
semantics.temporal_rule: Points/evidence retain time distribution instead of collapsing into one timeless total.

invariants.rule: Identity, portfolio evidence and merit semantics have explicit owners and cannot silently substitute for one another.

hard_gates.condition: weekly cadence anchored to Project start instead of identity registration
sub-hour atom used as canonical merit atom
